parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'content_plan', vars: { week_start: $json.week_start, channels: $json.channels.join(', '), posts_per_channel: $env.PLAN_POSTS_PER_CHANNEL || 3, recent_titles: $json.recent_titles, themes: $env.PLAN_THEMES || null, performance: $json.performance } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const lines = $input.all().map(i => `- ${i.json.scheduled_at.slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')} ${i.json.channel}: ${i.json.title} (#${i.json.id})`);
return [{ json: { text: `*Content plan for week of ${$('Prepare').first().json.week_start}* — ${lines.length} ideas in the calendar\n${lines.join('\n')}` } }];

// Skip notifying when no destination is configured.
return (String($env.NOTIFY_FORMAT || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'telegram' ? $env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN && $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID : $env.NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL) ? $input.all() : [];
